rule.criterion: Exactly two continuation sentences, optionally preceded by the supplied opening sentence; exclude an explicit non-story introduction from narrative count.

questions:
Given the following opening sentence, write the next two sentences of a story.

Input:
Alice stepped out into the garden.

A.text: The sun was just beginning to rise, casting a golden glow over the dew-covered flowers. A soft breeze carried the scent of lavender and fresh earth, making her heart feel lighter than it had in weeks.

B.text: The sun was just beginning to rise, casting a golden glow over the dewy grass. A gentle breeze carried the scent of blooming jasmine and something sweet and unfamiliar.

C.text: The sun was just beginning to rise, casting a golden glow over the dew-covered flowers. A soft breeze carried the scent of lavender and fresh earth, making her heart feel lighter than it had in weeks.

D.text: The sun was just beginning to rise, casting a golden glow over the dewy petals of the flowers. A gentle breeze carried the scent of blooming jasmine, and in the distance, a pair of birds chirped in harmony.
